flags.purpose: Filter TCP connections by state (Listen, Established, TimeWait, CloseWait, SynSent, etc.) to focus on meaningful sessions.
flags.security_use_case: Identify active outbound sessions to public IPs that may indicate C2 or reverse shells.
flags.threat_detected: Live command-and-control channels, data exfiltration streams, reverse callbacks.
flags.detection_pattern: State = Established AND RemoteAddress not in private ranges.
flags.forensic_value: Shows real-time external communication paths during incident response.
flags.baseline_value: Most established connections should be to trusted corporate or known internet services.
flags.safe_followup: Use Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess to identify process; capture trace if suspicious.

flags.purpose: Identify services listening on commonly abused web ports.
flags.security_use_case: Detect rogue web servers, web shells, or port-forwarding tools.
flags.detection_pattern: State = Listen AND LocalPort in (80,443,8080) AND OwningProcess not expected.
flags.forensic_value: Maps listening ports to owning process for rapid triage.
flags.baseline_value: Only approved web services should listen on these ports.
flags.safe_followup: Map PID with Get-Process; review firewall exposure.

flags.purpose: Filter connections by a specific remote IP (from threat intel).
flags.security_use_case: Find all processes communicating with known malicious infrastructure.
flags.threat_detected: Ongoing C2 communication and malware persistence.
flags.baseline_value: No legitimate process should connect to malicious IOCs.
flags.safe_followup: Block IP via firewall; terminate owning process after validation.

flags.purpose: Check which services bind to specific interfaces on multi-homed systems.
flags.security_use_case: Ensure sensitive services are not exposed on external adapters.
flags.threat_detected: Service unintentionally exposed to untrusted network.
flags.detection_pattern: LocalAddress bound to external adapter AND State = Listen.
flags.forensic_value: Reveals interface binding mistakes used by attackers.
flags.baseline_value: Critical services bound only to internal/private adapters.
flags.safe_followup: Adjust service binding or firewall rules.

flags.purpose: Show all TCP connections opened by a specific process ID.
flags.security_use_case: Investigate suspicious processes for abnormal network activity.
flags.forensic_value: Ties network behavior to executable on disk.
flags.baseline_value: Applications should connect only to expected domains/IPs.
flags.safe_followup: Hash executable; inspect modules and command line.

flags.purpose: Filter by network category profile (Internet, Datacenter, Compat).
flags.security_use_case: Detect services exposed under Internet profile unintentionally.
flags.threat_detected: Sensitive services listening on untrusted network category.
flags.forensic_value: Shows exposure due to incorrect network profile.
flags.baseline_value: Sensitive services should not bind under Internet profile.
flags.safe_followup: Correct network profile and binding configuration.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Finds non-standard listening ports often used by malware.

powerful_combinations.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -RemotePort 443,4443,8443 -State Established | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess | Select-Object Name,Path,Company }
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Maps encrypted traffic ports to actual processes for legitimacy checks.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Differentiate normal HTTPS from malware TLS tunnels.
